nav_label: (none) — profile card in sidebar, or avatar menu → Profile

actions.outcome: Closes the menu and displays this screen with cleared fields

actions.kind: Toggle buttons data-pw-toggle, aria-label "Show password" / "Hide password", aria-pressed
actions.outcome: Swaps that one field between masked and plain text. Reset to masked every time the screen is entered or a save succeeds

Runs the validation below. If all pass: clears all fields, resets toggles and checklist, shows the toast. Nothing is sent or stored: no current-password check, no new-password store, no sign-out of other sessions, no email notice
actions.who_may: any signed-in user, own account only
actions.disabled_when: never (always pressable). Exercised on the running prototype (Playwright): with valid Current, New and Confirm values, pressing Enter in Confirm shows the toast "Password updated successfully." and clears the fields; with Current empty and New "abc", pressing Enter in Current shows "Current password is required." and, under New password, "Password does not meet all the requirements.". The untyped button is the form's default submit button, so Enter fires the same handler as a click; the onsubmit="return false" form never navigates

actions.outcome: Leaves for the dashboard; typed values are not saved and are wiped on the next entry

validation.rule: Required (truthy value; not trimmed, so a single space passes)
Must equal the account's existing password; locked out after N failed attempts
Max 128 characters (no point accepting more than a new password can be)

validation.message: row "At least 12 characters"; on submit "Password does not meet all the requirements."
hint, then "Password does not meet all the requirements."

validation.rule: At least one of each: uppercase A–Z, lowercase a–z, digit 0–9, and a symbol from ! @ # $ % ^ & * ( ) _ + - = [ ] { } \| ; ' : " , . < > ? (ASCII only; space, ~, `  `, /, \ do not count; the UI says only "(!@#$…)") | declared (PASSWORD_RULES`) | live; Update | as above
Must differ from Current password (exact string compare)
validation.when: Update, only after all other fields pass
validation.message: "New password must be different from the current one." (shown under New password)

validation.rule: Must not contain the user's name or email; not in a common/breached list; not equal to the last N passwords; maximum age / expiry
Inputs are type=password with autocomplete current-password / new-password / new-password (password managers supported). </> stripping does not apply to password inputs
No edit capability; may a user change their own phone/email?

states.when: a crop of the same render as profile.png, embedded above as the default state; adds no state

states.shows: The details card is hard-coded text: nothing is read from data
Cannot occur: the current password is never checked. Undefined — OQ-22-03
Every role sees the same hard-coded "Admin Admin / Administrator". Undefined — OQ-22-02

acceptance_criteria.title: Open Profile from the avatar menu

steps.text: I am signed in on any screen
I press the "Admin Admin ▾" avatar and choose Profile
My Profile shows with Email itdept@ta.org.jm, Phone +1 876 555 0100, Role Administrator, Level — and Last login 2026-10-22 16:08
the three password fields are empty and masked
I am on My Profile
I type "Abcdefghij1" into New password
"An uppercase letter", "A lowercase letter" and "A number" are ticked green, "At least 12 characters" and "A special character" are not
the label reads "Good"
I am on My Profile
I type "Abcdefghijk1!" into New password
all five rules are ticked, four segments are green and the label reads "Strong"

acceptance_criteria.title: Submit with problems shows all errors

steps.text: Current password is empty, New password is "Abcdefghijk1!" and Confirm is "x"
I press Update password
"Current password is required." shows under Current password and "Passwords do not match." under Confirm
focus moves to Current password and no toast appears
Current "OldPassw0rd!x", New "abc", Confirm "abc"
I press Update password
"Password does not meet all the requirements." shows under New password and the fields keep their values
Current, New and Confirm all hold "Abcdefghijk1!"
I press Update password
"New password must be different from the current one." shows under New password
Current "OldPassw0rd!x", New "Abcdefghijk1!", Confirm "Abcdefghijk1!"
I press Update password
all three fields empty, the checklist returns to unticked, and a toast reads "Password updated successfully."
I remain on My Profile, still signed in
I am on My Profile
I press the eye in New password
only New password shows plain text and its label reads "Hide password"; the other two stay masked
I typed a value in New password
I press Cancel
the Dashboard shows, and re-opening Profile shows empty fields
